# Vendored Arazzo 1.0 JSON Schema

`arazzo-1.0-schema.json` is the **official** OpenAPI Initiative JSON Schema for
Arazzo v1.0.x documents, vendored verbatim so the conformance test runs offline
(Pattern B: the falsifiable local check ships first).

| | |
|---|---|
| `$id` | `https://spec.openapis.org/arazzo/1.0/schema/2024-08-01` |
| source | `OAI/Arazzo-Specification@main:_archive_/schemas/v1.0/schema.json` |
| retrieved | 2026-08-07 |
| sha256 | `d6dec4ebb499b4f6083ce982ed3fa0347aa1268e3cc653131d59a476773f158c` |
| licence | Apache-2.0 (OpenAPI Initiative) |

**Why vendored rather than asserted.** `tests/test_arazzo.py` validates
`gecko.arazzo.to_arazzo()` output against *this* file, not against a hand-written
list of "fields we think Arazzo has". A serializer that merely emits JSON we
invented would pass a hand-written check and fail a real runtime; only the real
schema catches that. The `jsonschema` validator is a **dev-group** dependency and
the test `importorskip`s it — `gecko-surf` itself gains no dependency.

Do not edit this file. Re-vendor from the upstream repo if the spec revises, and
update the hash above.
